name: opendbs
description: OpenDBS - High-performance database with Node.js API and Rust storage engine
author: OpenDBS Team
_comment_rust_build_windows: On Windows, building against the MSVC toolchain fails with 'libnode.dll not found' in napi-build. Fix: install the GNU toolchain + a MinGW/MSYS2 gcc, then run `rustup override set stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` inside rust-engine/ once. `npm run build:rust` then produces opendbs-engine.win32-x64-msvc.node despite using the GNU toolchain -- that's just napi-rs's own target-detection naming, the binary is correct and loads fine.
